_about: Hydrogen (1) + n-decane (2): P, x, y at 462.5, 503.4, 543.0 and 583.5 K from Sebastian et al. (1980), flow apparatus, as compiled in IUPAC SDS 5/6. Rows with x = 0 are pure decane.

source.citation: H. M. Sebastian, J. J. Simnick, H. M. Lin, K.-C. Chao, Gas-liquid equilibrium in the hydrogen + n-decane system at elevated temperatures and pressures, J. Chem. Eng. Data 25 (1980) 68-70
source.access: The original article is not open; its values are compiled in IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 5/6, Hydrogen and Deuterium (C. L. Young, Pergamon, 1981; copyright IUPAC), which IUPAC publishes as open access at iupac.github.io
source.tables: IUPAC Solubility Data Series Vol. 5/6 (1981) pp 369-370 (PDF pp 386-387); P printed in atm and MPa, the MPa column copied; estimated error T 0.2 K, P 0.003 MPa below 3.5 MPa and 0.02 MPa above, x and y 1 %
source.transcription: Read from the scanned page image at 200-400 dpi; compared value by value with an independent transcription in another assistant's literature package (they agree except where noted). The person checking should compare each row with the page.
